techniques.summary: During a whip or a defocus pulse the content changes where the eye cannot hold it: typed words are replaced mid-whip; a window zooms out into extreme blur and a notification resolves at the same spot; a box goes fully soft and comes back in a new layout; a big blurred blob resolves into the next header; a cut lands blurred and morphs into a near-identical sharp image; a pill becomes a portrait card behind a defocus pulse.
techniques.recipe: defocusPulse({ at, peakSigma, scaleJump }) + swapAt(peak); whip + swapAt for the whip version. Anatomy: Sharpness falls to near zero for 2-4 f; swap on the softest frame; the new element resolves as a lens would (focus lagging position). Sound: A whoosh and sub on the peak; an impact on the resolve.
techniques.timing: 24-60 f; blur peak 4-8 f; resolve tau 6-7 f.
techniques.use_when: Any content change inside a fast move.
techniques.avoid_when: Swapping on a sharp frame.

techniques.name: Motion blur drawn as a few visible copies
techniques.summary: On the fastest frames the blur is not a smooth streak: a launching dot is two or three overlapping soft discs stacked along its path, a whipping sentence prints three or four offset copies of each word; speed reads as a graphic.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: render the moving layer four times at sub-frame offsets with opacity 1/4 each (the shutter with four samples and no extra blur). Anatomy: 3-4 taps at t - k dt / 4, each 25-35 % opacity, plus about 6 px of blur; dot taps 9-12 px apart, text taps about 18 px apart; only above about 12 px/f of travel. Sound: Whooshes on the whips.
techniques.timing: 6-12 f per move.
techniques.use_when: Graphic, flat films; dots and type in flight.
techniques.avoid_when: Photographic footage; films that use true shutter blur elsewhere.

techniques.name: Text collapses into an object
techniques.summary: A finished line stops being text and becomes a thing: both ends rush to the centre while it thickens into a short fat pill (area kept), it is replaced by one solid bar of its size that slides into a chat pill, it blooms and squeezes into a small pill, it heats and collapses to a few dots that draw an icon, blocks advance and eat it from its end, or it is erased in chunks while a square grows in the cleared space.
techniques.recipe: <MorphChain states={[line, bar|pill|dots, object]}> with a collapse window (ease-in, blur 12-20 px) and a one-frame CHAIN_STEP swap. Anatomy: Width 258 -> 66 px, height 10 -> 28 (area constant) on a cubic-in; a solid bar for 3 f; dots for 2 f then strokes; chunks of 2-3 letters a frame. Sound: A lead-in to a kick; a kick on the eat; a click on the erase. Materials: The object can be a flip-book pixel sprite filled with a grainy two-hue gradient (cells about 40 px, gradient at 135 deg, monochrome grain at about 4 %, rim cells in a deeper shade), one drawing every 4 f, pushing the next word aside as it widens.
techniques.timing: 10-50 f; the collapse itself 6-16 f.
techniques.use_when: Moving from a statement to the product (the line becomes the input, the button, the icon).
techniques.avoid_when: Collapsing a line before it has been read.
techniques.materials: The object can be a flip-book pixel sprite filled with a grainy two-hue gradient (cells about 40 px, gradient at 135 deg, monochrome grain at about 4 %, rim cells in a deeper shade), one drawing every 4 f, pushing the next word aside as it widens.
conditions: gradients baked as dithered plates and moved by transform

techniques.name: Camera passes through a ring of cards
techniques.summary: A ring of cards seen down its axis: thin radial slivers grow in from the frame edges and thicken (tints first, then real thumbnails); the camera rises and pushes through the ring, the arch of cards sweeps out of frame, and the first word is already there on the other side.
techniques.recipe: Cards on a 3D ring (rotateY per card, translateZ radius) with the camera's pitch and k. Anatomy: Slivers coverage 1 -> 37 %; push with vertical flow 2 -> 43 px/f; sweep 13 f; word 20 f expo-out. Sound: A chat pop; a sub-drop as the camera exits the ring. Materials: The ring's cards arrive as needle-like spikes radiating from the frame edges in a two-hue gradient (outer warm, inner deep), pure colour for 12 f; as they widen they reveal video cards seen edge-on, still tinted (colour blend, opacity = 1 - width), and the tint drains in 8 f to true colour.
techniques.timing: Slivers 28 f; push 60 f.
techniques.use_when: A gallery of examples as a portal.
techniques.avoid_when: Flat rings (it needs the perspective).
techniques.materials: The ring's cards arrive as needle-like spikes radiating from the frame edges in a two-hue gradient (outer warm, inner deep), pure colour for 12 f; as they widen they reveal video cards seen edge-on, still tinted (colour blend, opacity = 1 - width), and the tint drains in 8 f to true colour.
conditions: gradients baked as dithered plates and moved by transform

techniques.name: Title fills with the next image and takes over
techniques.summary: A title pushes in accelerating, punches +11 % in one frame, its letters fill with the next image, giant echo copies appear, and the image takes over the frame.
techniques.recipe: <TypeWindow> (letters as the window, stepped growth) with a SnapZoom punch. Anatomy: Push +6 % accelerating; punch 1 f; window 23 f; step-out 1 f. Sound: A drum hit at +45 dB on the step-out.
techniques.timing: 95 f in all.
techniques.use_when: The title before the main section.
techniques.avoid_when: Thin letters.

techniques.name: Line leaves upward as the next rises from below
techniques.summary: A finished line or status accelerates upward (with a little vertical blur) and leaves, while the next line or list rises from below, blurred, and eases into place: the reading direction becomes the motion.
techniques.recipe: Words exit 'launch' upward + the next Words rising with focusIn. Anatomy: Exit ease-in 2 -> 19 px/f; entry rise 83 px blurred, easing 8-16 f. Sound: A punchy hit on the arrival.
techniques.timing: Exit 20 f; entry 16-20 f; overlap 4-6 f.
techniques.use_when: Sequences of statements or status steps.
techniques.avoid_when: Both lines on screen and sharp at once.

techniques.name: Two discs converge and their overlap opens a world
techniques.summary: Two dark spheres slide together until only their lens-shaped overlap remains at the centre, rimmed in light, and the next world shows through that overlap.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: an SVG mask made of the intersection of two circles (clipPath inside clipPath), positions in closed form. Anatomy: Intersection of two circles as the mask; quad in-out. Sound: The beat (+10 ms); a glockenspiel just before.
techniques.timing: 12 f at 60 fps.
techniques.use_when: Two ideas meeting; a hero reveal.
techniques.avoid_when: Discs that do not read as objects.

techniques.name: Exit at speed into a dark frame, next world fades up
techniques.summary: The outgoing shot accelerates away (an orbit ramping into a 3-frame whip, an assembly flying off, a pull-out that darkens, a last line pushing in while the floor glow sinks, a logo drifting back as it fades) into one or two dark frames, and the next world fades up from them in a few frames.
techniques.recipe: blackDipState({ cut, black: 2, fadeUp: 8 }) after an exit on E.launchIn. Anatomy: Exit ease-in to 15 %/f or 308 px/f; 1-2 black frames; fade-up about 10 f. Sound: A beat on the black (+2 ms); a music gap begins; sub-bass under the glow.
techniques.timing: Exit 18-50 f; black 2-5 f at 60; fade-up 8-10 f.
techniques.use_when: Changing worlds; before the end card.
techniques.avoid_when: Long blacks (over 2 frames at 24-30 fps).

techniques.name: Short fade through white between sections
techniques.summary: Section changes on a white ground use quick fades through white (10-28 f at 60 fps).
techniques.recipe: blackDipState with the ground colour white and fadeUp 8-14 f. Anatomy: Opacity dip to the white ground and back. Sound: Often a ding or a pluck.
techniques.use_when: Light-ground films.
techniques.avoid_when: Dark grounds (use a cut).

techniques.name: Next shot opens as a window; the old shot steps back
techniques.summary: A rectangle opens around the product showing the next shot at 1:1 while the old shot shrinks into a card on paper in a few held steps; or a framed photo unfolds from portrait to landscape in two stages.
techniques.recipe: <Window rects oldScale cadence>. Anatomy: Old shot 1 -> 0.94 -> 0.80 on 16 fps holds; window grows each step. Sound: Sub-bass and a kick.
techniques.use_when: Product-to-world transitions; a framed image growing.
techniques.avoid_when: Smooth tweens (the steps are the look).

techniques.name: Old words step into depth, new words step out
techniques.summary: Copies of the old words shrink into depth in steps while copies of the new line grow out of depth along the same axis, jitter for a few frames and lock; trails fade.
techniques.recipe: Build: <ZSwarm at x y old={line} next={line}> (fx/Gather): the old line steps back -0.15 scale per 30 fps frame (6 steps), the new one steps out from 0.2 by +0.10 (8 steps, 4 f behind), each step leaving two fading copies (45 %, 20 %); the new line jitters 6 f (6 px) and locks: 26 f in all. Anatomy: Old -0.15 scale a frame for 6 f, new +0.10 a frame for 8 f, linear; jitter 4 f; trails of each step fading. Sound: A punchy impact at full scale.
techniques.timing: 26 f at 60 fps.
techniques.use_when: A techno title change; a hook line swap.
techniques.avoid_when: Calm films.

techniques.name: Zoom into a letter until it fills the frame
techniques.summary: The middle letters of a word scale up inside their own box at a constant x1.42 a frame (x8 in 6 f) until one glyph part fills the frame, then a match cut to a label box of the same shape.
techniques.recipe: zoomThrough({ factor: 8, frames: 14, box: glyphBox }) or <TypeMask> push; handoffShot carrying k. Anatomy: Constant log rate; the glyph's box as the cover target; label expo-out after the cut. Sound: A drip or bubble on the cover.
techniques.timing: Zoom 14 f; label 22 f.
techniques.use_when: From a word into its meaning; a title into the first scene.
techniques.avoid_when: Letters with thin strokes (the fill reads as a flash).

techniques.name: Line whose stagger and fade shrink word by word
techniques.summary: Each later word starts sooner and fades faster than the one before, so the line gathers speed into its payoff (often the brand name).
techniques.recipe: <Words cadence="accelerate" accelTo={0.4}>. Anatomy: Geometric gaps (0.30, 0.23, 0.13, 0.10 s), fades shortening with them; variant: words cut on and slide only their last 10-12 px. Sound: A stab on word 1; or none.
techniques.timing: Gaps 18 -> 6 f at 60 fps; second line fades 12 f with 6-8 f stagger.
techniques.use_when: A payoff line, the last line of an act.
techniques.avoid_when: Every line (one accelerating run per act).

techniques.name: Anagrams reshuffle and lock
techniques.summary: Two jumbled words sit apart and every 2-3 frames their letters reshuffle (real anagrams of the target words) while they converge and lock; or one word becomes another by swapping letters one at a time.
techniques.recipe: <Scramble steps> (anagram stages); letter swap with Scramble order 'ltr' and steps of one letter. Anatomy: Letters re-ordered in steps, colour shifting each step; convergence on the last step; letter-swap variant: letters drop or rise a few px as they change. Sound: Ticks on the steps.
techniques.timing: Steps every 4-6 f at 60 fps; 34 f; letter swap about 2 f per letter.
techniques.use_when: A name or a claim that is "made" in front of the viewer.
techniques.avoid_when: Long words (beyond about 8 letters it reads as noise).

techniques.name: Words rise and drop onto one baseline with overshoot
techniques.summary: One word rises from below and the next drops from above onto a shared baseline, each landing with a real overshoot, while the background pans with a pulse.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: per word a damped spring on y (SPR.landing) from ±0.8 em. Anatomy: Alternate directions; landing overshoot 11-19 %, zeta 0.46-0.57; a 2-step rise. Sound: A kick on the first landing, onsets per word.
techniques.timing: Landings 12-22 f; pan 72 f.
techniques.use_when: A playful two-word title on a coloured field.
techniques.avoid_when: A film that already spends its one spring elsewhere.

techniques.name: Words blur out and vanish
techniques.summary: Text softens and fades together (blur to about 40 px with opacity on one clock), often followed by exactly one empty frame; or the previous words turn grey and blurred and stay behind the new ones as a ghost.
techniques.recipe: <DefocusCut out empty={1}>; the ghost as a RackFocus level kept behind the new line. Anatomy: Blur 8-40 px and opacity together, most of the blur late; one empty frame; ghost variant: grey, blurred, held behind. Sound: A level swell before the cut; a quiet breath.
techniques.timing: 8-18 f; empty 1 f.
techniques.use_when: Calm statements leaving; a line that should feel spoken into silence.
techniques.avoid_when: Blur on small UI type; a hero line or a statement (they leave at speed: slide, drift, spread, collapse).

techniques.name: Braces jump apart and the words swap inside
techniques.summary: To insert or swap a word between braces, the closing brace jumps outward one frame before the new word cuts on (59-73 % of its travel in that frame); for a swap, the braces accelerate apart during the last 0.4 s of the hold and the words change exactly at peak velocity.
techniques.recipe: Build: <Brackets phrases={[{ at, text }...]} x y font braceColor mode="insert"|"peak"> (fx/Brackets): insert: the closing brace jumps 66 % of its travel one frame before the word, then settles (10 f); peak: the braces run apart on an in-out (60 f) and the words swap on its fastest frame (a velocity seam). Anatomy: Braces are separate glyphs with their own motion; jump frame, expo settle (k 7-12); a 14 f drift; swap at the fastest frame. Sound: The audio onset with the word (-2 ms); the biggest hit (kick + sub-drop) on a swap.
techniques.timing: Settle 10-12 f; swap run 60 f (in-out with the peak at the swap).
techniques.use_when: Swapping the key word of a held statement; code-like or product-like copy.
techniques.avoid_when: Serif or decorative braces outside a supplied brand.

techniques.name: Sans line with a contrasting-voice payoff word
techniques.summary: A short phrase pairs a plain sans word with a payoff word in a contrasting voice (a handwritten script, a serif italic, small caps); the contrasting word enters 5-7 frames later.
techniques.recipe: <Words> with the payoff word in the second face and its own start. Anatomy: Sans word blur-fade-rise; contrasting word later; varied exits; a one-frame blank between phrases; variant: display caps fading in while a small italic connector types. Sound: A quiet breath before each cut.
techniques.timing: Entry 10-16 f; contrasting word +10-14 f; hold creeping 146 f.
techniques.use_when: "No X." style lists; editorial films.
techniques.avoid_when: Films whose brand has one family only.
techniques.ban_safe_variant: Contrast by weight and size within the brand family (light vs heavy, or a mono payoff word).

techniques.name: Word cuts on and drifts, then leaves the same way
techniques.summary: Labels appear in one frame at full ink and keep drifting (diagonally apart, or sideways on an expo-out), hold briefly and accelerate out along the same line.
techniques.recipe: <Words dur={1} rise={0}> inside a drift transform; exit 'launch' along the drift. Anatomy: Cut-on (1 f fade), drift 60-70 px, short hold, launch exit. Sound: Each label near a beat.
techniques.timing: Drift 26-68 f; hold 8 f; exit 16 f accelerating (2, 4, 8, 14 px...).
techniques.use_when: Two labels that relate (a pair of words apart in the frame); a single word between scenes.
techniques.avoid_when: Text that must sit still to be read.

techniques.name: Vertical drum swap with a heat and a tilt
techniques.summary: Before each swap the word heats in colour, tilts away like a drum face and exits up while the next word (or icon tile) enters from below; the last one flattens and exits.
techniques.recipe: MaskRise in + an exit with rotateX(-60deg) and rise; colour via HueSweep back. Anatomy: Heat 23 f, rotateX tilt on exit, entry from below. Sound: Plucks on the swaps; a shutter on the last.
techniques.timing: Heat 23 f; exit 20 f; entry 23-25 f; final flatten 10 f.
techniques.use_when: A list of sources or places in one sentence ("from Phone / Folders / Drives").
techniques.avoid_when: More than three swaps.

techniques.name: Echo copies slide out from behind the word
techniques.summary: Copies of a word, each on its own solid knock-out box so the nearer copies hide the farther ones, slide out from behind the word in rings, then contract back.
techniques.recipe: Build: <EchoCopies at offset={{ x, y }} x y ground back={{ at }}>{word}</EchoCopies> (fx/Echoes): rings at +1, +3, +4 f (25 fps) slide out on E.snapOut over 27 f (half way in 0.05 s, 90 % in 0.2 s), each on a box of the ground's colour so nearer rings hide farther ones; contract back in 20 f. Anatomy: Rings at +1, +3, +4 f, each expo-out (t50 0.04 s, t90 0.20 s); contraction 20 f. Sound: The full bed enters on the drop.
techniques.timing: 72 f in all.
techniques.use_when: A key word that should feel multiplied or scaled ("Scaling").
techniques.avoid_when: Long words; more than once.

techniques.name: Old word erodes while new letters rise
techniques.summary: The old word disappears from its end, letter by letter, each blurring out horizontally, while the new word's letters rise into place behind it.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: Letters build for the incoming word plus a per-letter exit (opacity and a horizontal ladder blur copy) in reverse order. Anatomy: Exit letters right to left, 1-2 f each with a horizontal smear; entry letters 3 f stagger, expo-out, full opacity in 3 f. Sound: Voice.
techniques.timing: 40 f in all; new letters 20 f each.
techniques.use_when: Swapping one key word in a held line.
techniques.avoid_when: Words the viewer has not read yet.

techniques.name: Word flips up from a flat line
techniques.summary: A word flips up about its baseline from a flat line (rotateX) while rising and darkening.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: rotateX(90deg -> 0) about the baseline with perspective 800 px plus the Words rise. Anatomy: Glyph height 12 -> 57 px in 3 frames, rise 66 px, grey to ink. Sound: None.
techniques.timing: Height 8 f, position 25 f, colour 20 f.
techniques.use_when: A word that should feel lifted off the page.
techniques.avoid_when: Thin type (the flat phase disappears).

techniques.name: Words fly in from behind the camera
techniques.summary: Each word starts about 10x its size (one letter fills the frame), blurred and off-centre, and shrinks into its slot: the words seem to come from behind the viewer.
techniques.recipe: <Oversize from={10} dur={23} defocus={14} defocusDur={18}> per word with an x offset that converges; stagger 10. Anatomy: Per word: scale 10x to 1, a lateral start (left, centre, right in turn), blur clearing as it shrinks; staggered. Sound: The first word on a kick (+19 ms); a soft air pass per word. As one line: `<TypeLine spec={{ preset: 'fly', text, at }}>` (each word from x5 and soft, landing in 14 f in log scale on E.snapOut, 10 f apart, touching; the spaces open after the last lands).
techniques.timing: About 23 f per word, stagger 10 f, sharp by the last word's landing.
techniques.use_when: A tagline or a closing line on a strong beat; once per film.
techniques.avoid_when: Calm films; more than 4 words.

techniques.name: Set line resolves from blur left to right
techniques.summary: The whole line is laid out at once but only the first words are sharp; sharpness travels across it left to right, and the last word closes a gap as it sharpens.
techniques.recipe: <FocusWord mode="ui"> with the line split into words. Anatomy: Per-word blur and opacity by position; last word gap close. Sound: None. Materials: An address bar built from separate soft pills the colour of the canvas, defined only by a drop shadow (0 6px 18px at 8 %) and an inner top highlight (0 -2px 6px white at 90 %), with thin black line icons; no borders. As one line: `<TypeLine spec={{ preset: 'glide', text, at }}>` (the set line slides in 2.4 em and slows into a drift while its words resolve left to right, 3.5 f apart, solid in 8 f).
techniques.timing: Sweep 34 f; gap close 16 f; continuous drift.
techniques.use_when: A sentence that reads in one sweep; a calm opener.
techniques.avoid_when: Lines the viewer has to wait for.
techniques.materials: An address bar built from separate soft pills the colour of the canvas, defined only by a drop shadow (0 6px 18px at 8 %) and an inner top highlight (0 -2px 6px white at 90 %), with thin black line icons; no borders.

techniques.name: Neighbouring words show as dim ghosts around the slot
techniques.summary: While a word sits in a slot, blurred dim copies of the previous and next words remain visible just outside the mask, like a slot-machine reel; a new line can cut in at 79 % defocused and grow while ghost copies spread above and below.
techniques.recipe: Build: <GhostReel n pitch swaps x y width slotH render> (fx/Reels): the slot sharp, the neighbours outside it through one fixed blur (6 px) at 20 %; each roll exits on E.buildIn (26 f) and settles on E.snapOut (16 f). Anatomy: Main word sharp in the slot; ghosts blurred, 10-25 % strength, moving with the roll; spreading ghosts on an ease-out. Sound: A kick on the swap.
techniques.timing: Grow 56 f; ghosts 52 f ease-out; exit 40 f ease-in.
techniques.use_when: Word swaps that should feel like a reel or a list; a line that is one of many.
techniques.avoid_when: Ghosts strong enough to be read (keep them under 25 %).

techniques.name: Tiny word in front of a giant ghost of itself
techniques.summary: A huge light-grey ghost of a word fills the frame behind a small black version of the same word, which doubles in size in one frame.
techniques.recipe: Two Words layers (ghost at display size, foreground small) + HardStep scale. Anatomy: Ghost at 3-5 % contrast; foreground step x2 in 1 f. Sound: None needed.
techniques.timing: Step 1 f; hold 70 f.
techniques.use_when: A word about size or scale ("Big").
techniques.avoid_when: Ghosts dark enough to compete.

techniques.name: Glyph scramble that locks into the word
techniques.summary: Random glyphs (letters, digits, symbols) cycle in each slot and lock into the word, left to right or out of order, with exactly one accent glyph at a time; a sentence can scramble out the same way.
techniques.recipe: <Scramble rateHz={10} order="ltr"> (or 'random'); accent glyph via the accent prop; declares the span stepped. Anatomy: Per slot 10 changes a second, locking in order; one glyph in the accent; variants: arrow or symbol glyphs decoding into a wordmark, each new letter accent first then all ink; a sentence dropping out to random glyphs while the title resolves in the accent and flips to ink. Sound: A UI pop on the scramble's start; the title can land in a stop-down silence. Materials: Two constructions. Halo scramble: the word cycles through whole random glyph sets, each held exactly 6 f (10 Hz), inside a soft white halo (a blurred copy at 20 px, 45 %, screen) with the scrambling accent glyphs carrying a smaller accent glow; the halo switches off on the lock frame as a cut, while the word settles from 1.2x to 1.0. Positional scramble: letters keep their slots, random letters drop out, foreign glyphs and ligatures appear in the gaps, then the new string resolves through a pale tint for one state before the ink (about 4 f per state).
techniques.timing: A state every 6 f (10 Hz); 7 states over 38 f; decode out 13 f, in 10 f, colour flip 1 f.
techniques.use_when: A product name, a code, a version, a title once per film.
techniques.avoid_when: Running copy; more than once per film.
techniques.materials: Two constructions. Halo scramble: the word cycles through whole random glyph sets, each held exactly 6 f (10 Hz), inside a soft white halo (a blurred copy at 20 px, 45 %, screen) with the scrambling accent glyphs carrying a smaller accent glow; the halo switches off on the lock frame as a cut, while the word settles from 1.2x to 1.0. Positional scramble: letters keep their slots, random letters drop out, foreign glyphs and ligatures appear in the gaps, then the new string resolves through a pale tint for one state before the ink (about 4 f per state).

techniques.name: Words hop between grid cells
techniques.summary: Words on small label boxes move one or two grid cells at a time, alternating axes like Manhattan routes, then all jump into the final sentence in one frame.
techniques.recipe: Build: <GridHop words={[{ path: manhattan(from, to), at }]} origin texts font box final={{ at, positions: sentencePositions(texts, x, y, font) }}> (fx/Echoes): one cell per hop on the stepped progress 0, .19, .36, .78, .95, 1 (9 f), axes alternating, then every word jumps into the sentence on one frame. Anatomy: Hops of 120 px on 16 fps steps (progress 0, 0.19, 0.36, 0.78, 0.95, 1); the final jump is one frame. Sound: Plastic clicks on the hops; a big click on the final jump.
techniques.timing: Each hop 8-10 f; run 75 f; final jump 1 f.
techniques.use_when: A sentence assembled from parts; layout tools, grids, editing products.
techniques.avoid_when: Long sentences.

techniques.name: Hero word shrinks in hard scale steps
techniques.summary: A hero word shrinks from 3.3x to rest in a few hard scale cuts with 0-2 frame holds and no tween (3.32 -> 1.71 -> 1.045 -> 1.0).
techniques.recipe: HardStep on scale. Anatomy: Steps on single frames, each about half the remaining scale. Sound: Key-click transients on the steps.
techniques.timing: 10 f at 60 fps.
techniques.use_when: A word arriving on key-click transients.
techniques.avoid_when: Smooth films.

techniques.name: One huge word fills the panel and pushes in
techniques.summary: One key verb alone fills the panel (15-19 % of its height) and pushes in +24 % on an expo-out.
techniques.recipe: Words + camera push (E.snapOut, +24 %). Anatomy: Single word, push on expo-out. Sound: On the swap after the zoom.
techniques.use_when: The verb of the claim, after a zoom-through.
techniques.avoid_when: Two words.

techniques.name: A highlight walks the line, parks on the keyword, new words type hot
techniques.summary: A grey line lights up in the accent as a whole, then the colour narrows to a window that walks word by word and parks on the keyword; new words then type in, each born in the accent and cooling to grey, while the keyword keeps its colour.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: word spans with a colour state per frame (the window index from the clock), then TypeOn for the continuation with a per-character cool. Anatomy: Whole-line flash 8 f; the window steps about every 8 f; park 24 f; typing about one character per 2 f with word-end pauses; typed letters cool accent -> grey over 12 f; every colour change is a linear lerp over 12-16 f, never a cut. Sound: None needed.
techniques.timing: About 90 f for the whole move.
techniques.use_when: A line inside a UI (a subtitle, a result) that carries the claim; two colours only.
techniques.avoid_when: Big display copy (use a tint wave or an ink path).

techniques.name: Words float away; the hub stays
techniques.summary: All the words drift up on an ease-in and disappear, while an icon stays exactly in place and gains a rounded container: it becomes the hub of the next scene.
techniques.recipe: Words exit 'launch' upward; Morph box around the icon. Anatomy: Words up 1 -> 12 px/f; the icon fixed; the container grows around it. Sound: An onset as the container appears.
techniques.use_when: Turning a statement into the product's centre.
techniques.avoid_when: Moving the hub.

techniques.name: Word inks along a colour path
techniques.summary: Each new word appears at full size but pale and walks along a colour path into the ink, letter by letter from one end; the colour change is the reveal.
techniques.recipe: <HueSweep> house one-hue path (9 f per word at 30 fps, words 10-12 f apart). Recipe: background-image a ten-stop gradient, background-size 300 % 100 %, background-clip text, background-position-x 100 -> 0 % over 48 f. Anatomy: Lightness held first, then darkened through the accent into the ink; the front crosses the word with the right end leading (or right to left for a cooling ramp); variant: the first word nudges 18 px into centre while it colours. Sound: A soft whoosh on the first word; word cadence off the beat. Materials: A wide spectral band slides right to left through the label and leaves ink behind: the line arrives as a horizontal rainbow (yellow, orange, magenta, red, olive), the band (about three times the label's width) slides left on a bezier (0.37, 0.13, 0.26, 0.95) at about 12 px/f, so mid-move the line reads warm at its end and cool at its start, and the tail of the band is ink. Ten stops from warm to green, teal, blue, navy and ink.
techniques.timing: 18-20 f per word, onsets 20-24 f apart; a ramp front of 13 f with a 30 f tail; AI lines 28-44 f each.
techniques.use_when: A text-led opener, an AI line that should feel generated, a keyword.
techniques.avoid_when: More than one per act; a full rainbow walk (it reads as a template).
techniques.materials: A wide spectral band slides right to left through the label and leaves ink behind: the line arrives as a horizontal rainbow (yellow, orange, magenta, red, olive), the band (about three times the label's width) slides left on a bezier (0.37, 0.13, 0.26, 0.95) at about 12 px/f, so mid-move the line reads warm at its end and cool at its start, and the tail of the band is ink. Ten stops from warm to green, teal, blue, navy and ink.
conditions: gradients baked as dithered plates and moved by transform
the film's one spectral accent

techniques.name: An icon stands in for a word in the sentence
techniques.summary: An icon takes a word's place inside the line: a mascot pops in where the next word would be while the giant word re-sets smaller; an outlined chip with an app logo sits inside the sentence, arriving in the accent and cooling, heating up before it swaps; a round clock icon between two words pops from 0.7 from defocus, saturates, then its hand ticks.
techniques.recipe: Words with an inline element slot (a span with an icon), entering with Oversize from 0.7. Anatomy: Icon 1.3-2x cap height; pop 7-30 f; colour cool 10 f, heat 15 f before a swap. Sound: The spoken word. Materials: An inline brand chip changes brand by rolling: the old content warms and fades, then rolls up out of the pill while the new name rolls in from below (both visible for 2 f), the pill's 1 px border following the text colour; 16 f in all.
techniques.use_when: Product names, apps, time, anything the viewer knows as an icon.
techniques.avoid_when: Icons that are unreadable at line size (at least 1.33x the cap height).
techniques.materials: An inline brand chip changes brand by rolling: the old content warms and fades, then rolls up out of the pill while the new name rolls in from below (both visible for 2 f), the pill's 1 px border following the text colour; 16 f in all.

techniques.name: In-place ink-up from partial strength
techniques.summary: Words or rows appear exactly in their final place, already 29-60 % strong on the first frame, and ink up to full with no movement at all; several words are often mid-fade together.
techniques.recipe: <Words rise={0} dur={20} stagger={8}> with the first-frame strength set by the ease (E.snapOut gives about 35 %); colour-from-tint via accent = the panel tint and accentHold 0. Anatomy: Opacity only (or a colour from the panel tint or a light grey to the ink). Variants: words land grey and snap to full ink on the frame the next word lands (the recency snap); data rows dim then bright 1-2 f apart; pairs of two words at a time for small UI copy; side words fading in 7 f after a hit. Sound: Key or click ticks on word onsets for a typed feel, otherwise none.
techniques.timing: First frame 29-60 % (house 38 %); 90 % by 10-20 f, full by 20-32 f on an expo-out. Stagger 4-12 f per word; lines 5-8 f apart; rows 2-4 f apart; a recency snap is one frame.
techniques.use_when: Dense layouts (a page, a card, data rows, captions on photos) where motion would fight the layout, and small UI copy.
techniques.avoid_when: A hero line that needs energy; long lines that would all be half-inked at once.

techniques.name: Line opens a gap for an inline object
techniques.summary: A sentence splits between two words, the halves part and an object grows in the gap: an image chip that hard-cuts through several clips, a thumbnail that swaps content while the line reflows, or a pill that grows and types a sub-line.
techniques.recipe: Build: <InlineGap leftText rightText at gap h swaps={[...]} items={[...]}> (fx/InlineGap): the halves part on E.glideOut (16 f; up to 76 for a wide gap), the chip grows from a 3 px bar once the gap is a third open (7 f) and its content hard-cuts on swaps; close={{ at }} shuts the gap (5 f, E.buildIn); anchor="left" moves only the right half; halves lets each half arrive on its own. inlineGapFrames() for the cues. Anatomy: Halves part 44-410 px (expo, slow 4 f start); the object grows from a 1 px bar; content swaps inside on hard cuts; the line reflows and the block zooms up to x1.76. Sound: On the big hit; a toggle click on the pill. Materials: The object can be a photo-real character: a tiny dot in the word gap grows 6 -> 30 px in 6 f, then into a round white portrait (soft drop shadow) while the halves fly apart past the frame edges, blurring up to 25 px as the camera pushes; the portrait then rises into the next UI's header.
techniques.timing: Part 16-76 f; object grows 7-18 f; swaps every 6-20 f; reflow 10 f; squeeze 8 f.
techniques.use_when: Showing what a word means ("[images]", "your [product]"); the product inside the copy.
techniques.avoid_when: Gaps that break the read (split at a natural pause).
techniques.materials: The object can be a photo-real character: a tiny dot in the word gap grows 6 -> 30 px in 6 f, then into a round white portrait (soft drop shadow) while the halves fly apart past the frame edges, blurring up to 25 px as the camera pushes; the portrait then rises into the next UI's header.

techniques.name: Words jump through positions, leaving fading stamps
techniques.summary: Words teleport on ones through about five converging positions on their way to the final line; every visited position leaves a stamp of the word that fades out, with corner ticks riding along.
techniques.recipe: Build: <EchoStamp at x y from={{ x: 640, y: -250 }} ticks={{ color }}>{word}</EchoStamp> (fx/Echoes): on ones at 30 fps through progress 0, .40, .60, .66, .75, hold, 1 (12 f at 60); each left position leaves a stamp from 75 % that fades in 10 f; the hold leaves none; two L ticks ride the live word. Anatomy: Positions on a converging path (progress 0, .40, .60, .66, .75, hold, 1); each stamp a copy at that position fading 0.2 per frame. Sound: An impact on the landing.
techniques.timing: 12 f at 60 fps for the jumps; stamps fade over 10 f; first jump 227-292 px.
techniques.use_when: A hook line that should feel like a camera-less glitch of motion; a title in a techno film.
techniques.avoid_when: Calm films; more than once.

techniques.name: Keyword sits in a highlight block or pill
techniques.summary: The keyword rises into a soft rounded highlight block of the accent that then wipes off, turns the accent in 2 frames, pops in a solid accent pill (62 % -> 100 % in 2 frames), or a pale card appears behind the key comment while the scroll settles; a mention is a tinted chip; two small accent ticks point at the selected row.
techniques.recipe: Words accentOn + a rounded rect behind the word (measured under FontGate) with a Wipe exit; pill pop via Oversize from 0.62 in 2 f. Anatomy: Block with a soft edge (about 25 px feather) sized to the word; rise 6 f, hold 10 f, wipe 12 f; pill pop 2 f linear. Sound: The voice on the keyword; a shutter click.
techniques.use_when: The one word or item that matters in a film, as its declared signature (one line).
techniques.avoid_when: A block or pill on more than one line of a film; more than one word per line.

techniques.name: Words land from four directions
techniques.summary: On grid paper, lines and words land with an expo-out from left, right, top and bottom in turn, with a small arrow: a kinetic poster.
techniques.recipe: Words with a per-word rise direction, stagger 6 f. Anatomy: Entries 2-4 f apart, each from a different side, 15 f each. Sound: None needed.
techniques.timing: 33 f in all.
techniques.use_when: Poster-style title cards.
techniques.avoid_when: Calm films.

techniques.name: Letter-by-letter fade across a word
techniques.summary: A word fades in letter by letter from left to right, about one letter a frame, each with a short fade; trailing letters can rise in one at a time while the line moves.
techniques.recipe: <Letters mode="pop"> (rise 0.19 em) or build. Anatomy: Each letter a 4-8 f fade (and optionally a 60 px rise at 50 % white); 1-2 f apart. Sound: A water-drop on the start. Materials: On huge words the newest letters develop through a soft luminance front rather than whole-word fades: a ramp ink -> mid grey -> pale over 4-5 letters (about 350 px at a 150 px cap height) runs across the line at 12-20 px/f, matching the camera pan, while new words still rise about a third of a line.
techniques.timing: 30 f for 11 letters; trailing letters 13 f with 1.5 f stagger.
techniques.use_when: An "Introducing" over a photo; the end of a line entering at the frame edge.
techniques.avoid_when: Body copy.
techniques.materials: On huge words the newest letters develop through a soft luminance front rather than whole-word fades: a ramp ink -> mid grey -> pale over 4-5 letters (about 350 px at a 150 px cap height) runs across the line at 12-20 px/f, matching the camera pan, while new words still rise about a third of a line.

techniques.name: Scattered letters assemble into the word
techniques.summary: The letters of the payoff word start scattered (random offsets above and below, grey, almost still), accelerate gently and snap into the word together, usually during a camera push.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: Letters positions from prefix widths, each offset by a seeded vector that decays on an ease-in. Anatomy: Per letter a seeded offset (up to 330 px), slow float, then an ease-in convergence with a hard landing; grey to ink on arrival. Sound: Voice; or a soft lock on the landing.
techniques.timing: 34-60 f; float 40 f, final convergence 13 f; each glyph expo-out when it lands.
techniques.use_when: The payoff word of an act; a word in a mono or brand face.
techniques.avoid_when: Fast films (the drift needs a beat to read).

techniques.name: Letters spread and double while the ground warms
techniques.summary: A stat's letters spread apart and get doubled outline ghosts while the ground warms to the accent in 4 frames.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: Letters tracking out + one outline copy offset per letter; ground via HardStep tween. Anatomy: Tracking out, outline ghost copies offset, ground colour step. Sound: None needed.
techniques.timing: 20 f; colour 10 f.
techniques.use_when: Leaving a statistic.
techniques.avoid_when: Warm grounds in a cool brand.

techniques.name: The gap opens before the word arrives
techniques.summary: The line starts sliding 3-6 frames before the next word (or avatar, or version token) appears, so the gap is already open when it lands; the newcomer can pop in at the slide's peak speed or shove the previous word aside.
techniques.recipe: <Chain recentre="slot" recentreLead={10}>. Anatomy: Lead 3-6 f; the token appears at peak slide speed; a shove of 70 px in 2 blurred frames plus a 3 f settle; an icon pushed back in two pushes. Sound: The token on a kick (+39 ms); a note or click on the avatar pop.
techniques.timing: Lead 6-12 f at 60 fps; slides 30-80 f quint-out.
techniques.use_when: Builds where the new element is visual (an avatar, a token, an icon).
techniques.avoid_when: Opening the gap so early that it reads as a mistake (over 8 f).

techniques.name: Word rises out of a baseline mask
techniques.summary: Each word rises from behind an invisible baseline mask while going grey to ink; the last word takes twice as long; verb-plus-object lines can follow with a 3 f lag.
techniques.recipe: <MaskRise lastScale={2} ink>. Anatomy: Rise of about 90 px from under the baseline, ink from grey; variant: staggered hard exit. Sound: Hits on each verb. As one line: the TypeLine preset `mask`.
techniques.timing: Rise 18-20 f; second word 6 f behind; exit 14 f; lines 60 f apart.
techniques.use_when: Short commands, verbs on hits, any line that should feel cut and precise.
techniques.avoid_when: Long lines (the masked rise loses its snap).

techniques.name: An object sweeps through and eats the text
techniques.summary: Something solid erases the words as it passes: a bar of the word's height sweeps across the keyword; a rule grows from the caret and the letters turn the accent and vanish one by one; a button slides over the line and the word disappears from its leading edge; an app icon slides to centre and the text left of it is clipped into its edge.
techniques.recipe: Build: <Knockout at from to text x y font mode="clip"|"letters"|"reveal" object="bar"|"rule"|(edgeX) => node accent> (fx/Knockout): one closed-form edge (24 f on E.softIn) clips the text at the object's leading edge; letters removes whole letters as the edge passes their centres (about 3 f apart), each lit in the accent just before it goes; reveal writes the line on behind the object. Anatomy: Clip edge = the object's leading edge; letters 3 f apart; partial letters visible at the edge. Sound: A whoosh tail.
techniques.use_when: Replacing a word with a product action; deleting the old way.
techniques.avoid_when: Objects that do not belong to the product.

techniques.name: Old line pushes up and dims in one frame
techniques.summary: When the second line arrives, the first moves up on a fast S-curve and drops to about a third of its strength in a single frame.
techniques.recipe: Words move on E.strongInOut + HardStep opacity. Anatomy: Move 111 px; opacity step 1 -> 0.36 on one frame. Sound: A kick.
techniques.timing: Move 28 f (peak 39 px/f); dim 1 f.
techniques.use_when: Two-line statements where the second line is the point.
techniques.avoid_when: Keeping both lines at full strength.

techniques.name: One word set apart in the line
techniques.summary: One word of a line is set heavier, or in the accent, from the moment it appears; ranked rows can carry medal tones on their numerals.
techniques.recipe: Words with a span override (accentOn index, or a weight). Anatomy: Weight step (regular to semibold or bold), or the accent colour; medal tones only on rank numerals. Sound: None.
techniques.timing: Static.
techniques.use_when: The key word of a closing line; the top three of a ranking.
techniques.avoid_when: More than one emphasised word per line.

techniques.name: Words or items drop out one by one
techniques.summary: A line or a set leaves in a designed order: words vanish from the end one frame apart while the line accelerates; words are removed one per frame until one remains; the dim line erases word by word while the big type drifts; chips fall off while words drop right to left; words spread apart and fade from the end while the camera zooms; alternate words drop out, then the rest; list lines slide out top first; image tiles cut off one at a time.
techniques.recipe: Words/Chain exit with exitOrder 'rtl' (2 f apart) or 'stagger'; HardStep for one-per-frame removals. Anatomy: 1-4 f between removals; order right-to-left, alternate, top-first or noun-last; optional drift on an ease-in under it. Sound: Mouse clicks; a deep boom; clicks on the drop-outs. Materials: Two more constructions: words defocus out one at a time from the line's end (blur 0 -> 8 px with opacity 1 -> 0 over 16 f, staggered 8-12 f) while the word gaps widen 40 %; or a list turns grey, then each line is cropped away from the left by a hard edge, top lines first, so the left edge forms a staircase (24 f) as the lines fade. For a TypeLine: `exit: 'slide'` carries the right-to-left drop-out on a sideways launch.
techniques.use_when: Exits that should read as a build in reverse; leaving one word alone.
techniques.avoid_when: All at once (that is a cut, not an exit).
techniques.materials: Two more constructions: words defocus out one at a time from the line's end (blur 0 -> 8 px with opacity 1 -> 0 over 16 f, staggered 8-12 f) while the word gaps widen 40 %; or a list turns grey, then each line is cropped away from the left by a hard edge, top lines first, so the left edge forms a staircase (24 f) as the lines fade.

techniques.name: Word wheel advances like a picker
techniques.summary: An inline chip rolls like a drum picker through options (neighbours above and below faded and blurred); a vertical list in a card advances one row every 4 frames with hard jumps through formats.
techniques.recipe: Build: <GhostReel mode="step" swaps={every 10 f}> (fx/Reels) for the hard-jumping card list; the default mode rolls like a drum picker (26 f exit, 16 f settle) with the neighbours softened above and below. Anatomy: Pitch about 56-120 px; neighbours 30-50 % and blurred; exit quad-in, settle cubic-out; hard jumps at 6 Hz. Sound: Ticks on percussion onsets.
techniques.timing: 48 f per roll; jumps every 10 f at 60 fps.
techniques.use_when: Options, formats, apps that the product supports.
techniques.avoid_when: More than about 12 options.

techniques.name: Small plain caption directly on the picture
techniques.summary: A short white sans caption (cap 2.3-2.8 % of the frame) sits centred on live footage or a photo's mid-tone, no box, no shadow, no scrim; the picture's shallow depth of field keeps it legible.
techniques.recipe: <Words> with no entrance (cut-on) at caption size over <Footage>/<Photo>. Anatomy: Centred, thin to regular weight, slight negative tracking. Sound: The voice; the caption already on screen at the first syllable.
techniques.timing: Present from the cut; held per tagline.
techniques.use_when: Voice-locked subtitles; taglines over a photo.
techniques.avoid_when: Busy, sharp backgrounds behind the caption.

techniques.name: Cut on low at full ink, slide home
techniques.summary: A word cuts on at full opacity a little below (or beside) its slot and slides home on an exponential, so the first frame is a clean hit and the motion is pure settle.
techniques.recipe: <Words dur={1} rise={0.45} riseUnit="em" riseDur={22} riseEase={E.snapOut} stagger={5}>; for a side entry rotate the rise direction. Anatomy: Opacity 1 from frame one; offset 0.27-0.45 of the cap height (18-56 px at 1080p) below or 66 px to the right; variant: two linear frames of 104 px before the expo tail for a word that must travel far (259 px); variant: slide left until it touches the previous word. Sound: Each word on a kick or a soft tick; a run of words gets one sound.
techniques.timing: Settle 10-38 f expo-out; stagger 2-5 f; a far travel uses 2 linear frames then 20 f expo.
techniques.use_when: Punchier copy on a beat, headline words on a coloured field, a word that should touch the one before it.
techniques.avoid_when: Very large type (the cut-on jump reads as a glitch above about 60 px of offset).

techniques.name: Letters appear in random order
techniques.summary: The letters of a label or status line appear one by one in a shuffled order (each faint first, then full) until the word is whole.
techniques.recipe: <Letters mode="pop"> with onsets taken from a seeded permutation of the letter indices. Anatomy: Seeded permutation of letter onsets; each letter faint -> full in 2-4 f. Sound: Voice or none.
techniques.timing: 24-32 f for a line (about one letter a frame) on an ease-in count.
techniques.use_when: A button label appearing, an "Analyzing..." status line.
techniques.avoid_when: Headlines.

techniques.name: Line re-centres on a long exponential
techniques.summary: The line keeps re-centring on a long soft exponential while words arrive (each sliding in a little from the right, or rising into place), so the whole line drifts to its centre as one tween.
techniques.recipe: <Chain recentre="glide"> (E.expo, recentreDur 46). Anatomy: Left edge decaying about 0.75 a frame; the line itself sliding in 150-275 px from the right while words rise every 7 f; an appended half arrives grey and darkens in 3 f. Sound: Chat pop or voice phrase onsets.
techniques.timing: Re-centre 30-60 f (t50 0.17 s, t90 0.47 s); words 14-18 f each, 6-14 f apart.
techniques.use_when: Calm, speech-paced lines; a second half appended after a pause.
techniques.avoid_when: Fast builds (the glide lags behind the words).

techniques.name: Line re-centres with most of the move on frame one
techniques.summary: When a word is appended to a centred line, the whole line jumps 44-88 % of the way to its new centre on the very frame the word appears and eases the rest; nothing slides under a word being read. A small icon can anchor the line and ride along.
techniques.recipe: <Chain recentre="jump"> (22 f on E.jump). Anatomy: First-frame share 55-84 % (house 66 % in the first 30 fps frame), the rest over 3-8 frames; the first frames may carry a short horizontal smear; variant: the pair re-centres in exactly one frame; variant: a stacked block of lines re-centres 6 f after each addition. Sound: Word onsets.
techniques.timing: 10-24 f in all; first-frame speed 21-77 px/f.
techniques.use_when: Every centred build line; captions appended word by word to the voice.
techniques.avoid_when: A slow glide under a word being read; jumping before the word exists.

techniques.name: Re-centre jumps on its own cadence
techniques.summary: A growing lockup or caption re-centres in one-frame jumps (about half a letter width) on a different cadence from the letters landing (jumps every 8 f, letters every 6 f), creeping between jumps; the re-centre can lead the word's resolve by 6 f.
techniques.recipe: <Chain recentre="jump" recentreDur={1}> inside <Stepped fps={7.5}> for the line, letters on their own grid via hotGlyphState. Anatomy: Jumps of 11-83 px; creep 2-3 px/f between; on twos for a stepped look. Sound: None of its own.
techniques.timing: Jumps every 8 f; letters every 6 f; two 2-frame moves of 20 px.
techniques.use_when: Logo lockups built letter by letter; stepped, graphic films.
techniques.avoid_when: Smooth films.

techniques.name: Word decodes from a low-res pixel version
techniques.summary: A word appears as a coarse low-resolution pixel version in the accent, then half-resolved in a pale tone, then crisp in the ink, one frame each, and settles with a small posterised overshoot.
techniques.recipe: <Pixelate> in-phase only on the word with a three-size ladder (pixelLadder of 3 sizes) and the colour stepped per state. Anatomy: Three resolution states, colour accent -> pale -> ink; a stepped spring settle. Sound: A drum on the decode, a kick on the settle.
techniques.timing: Decode 7 f (one state per 2-3 f at 60 fps); settle 7 f on twos.
techniques.use_when: Words in a film about images, rendering or AI generation.
techniques.avoid_when: Small type (the low-res stage is unreadable mush below about 60 px).

techniques.name: Sentence lands with a ribbon tail
techniques.summary: After a whip cut the sentence is still travelling and each later word sits progressively lower and later, so the line lands like a ribbon settling from its head.
techniques.recipe: Words with stagger 2-3 f and rise growing per index (rises[]), carried from the whip speed. Anatomy: Per-word delay and a vertical offset growing with the index; the head word lands first. Sound: The cut on a hit (+48 ms).
techniques.timing: 45 f expo-out; the second word half-way at 5 f.
techniques.use_when: The first line after a whip.
techniques.avoid_when: Long sentences.

techniques.name: Masked roll swap with a pre-zoom
techniques.summary: A word inside a bracket rolls up out of the mask while the next word rolls in from below (vertical blur on the roll), after a small anticipation zoom; the bracket grows to the new width.
techniques.recipe: MaskRise for the incoming word, an upward launch exit for the outgoing one inside one clip; the bracket width via a 14 f tween; SnapZoom pre with a 4 % build. Anatomy: Pre-zoom (anticipation), roll up/out and up/in, box 175 -> 327 px, cubic-out settle. Sound: A key or kick on the roll.
techniques.timing: Pre-zoom 8 f; roll 10 f; settle 14 f.
techniques.use_when: Swapping the key noun of a held line on a beat.
techniques.avoid_when: Swaps faster than every 1.5 s.

techniques.name: Line opens room, then the key word types in
techniques.summary: A held line accelerates sideways to open room, then the key word types in letter by letter in the accent, and the line leaves with blur.
techniques.recipe: <LineSnap mode="room"> then <TypeOn kind="human"> in the opened slot; exit 'launch'. Anatomy: Pre-shift accelerating (-2 -> -36 px/f), typing about one letter a frame, exit left with blur. Sound: Voice.
techniques.timing: Pre-shift 20 f; typing 20 f; exit 12 f.
techniques.use_when: The key word of a statement.
techniques.avoid_when: Room moves slower than the typing.

techniques.name: Old line shrinks out, new line swaps in large
techniques.summary: The old line shrinks a little on an ease-in, then on one frame the new line replaces it at 104-108 % and eases down to size: a swap with a breath.
techniques.recipe: Words exit 'launchFade' on scale + Oversize from 1.08 on the swap frame. Anatomy: Shrink to 95.6 %, hard swap, 108 % -> 100 % ease-out. Sound: A whoosh pair, or on the beat.
techniques.timing: Out 14-20 f, in 20 f, swap 0 f.
techniques.use_when: Status lines, a title swapping to a tagline.
techniques.avoid_when: Big scale ranges (keep it under 10 %).

techniques.name: Short stepped or accelerating fade-out
techniques.summary: When a fade is right, it is short and shaped: secondary labels fade out with an accelerating opacity, staggered, as the main element arrives; a phrase goes translucent on one frame and is gone on the next; text fades in five equal steps the frame before a colour beat; a caption fades as the picture fills the frame over it.
techniques.recipe: Words exit 'launchFade' with a short outDur, or HardStep opacity steps. Anatomy: Ease-in opacity over 4-14 f; 2-frame exit; 5 linear steps. Sound: None; the next element's sound.
techniques.use_when: Secondary text clearing the stage for the hero; text under a growing picture.
techniques.avoid_when: Long linear fades of the main line.

techniques.name: Exit by accelerating shrink or recede
techniques.summary: A held word or text card leaves by scaling down about its centre on an ease-in (60 % of the shrink in the last 10 %), the pane easing back with it, then a hard cut (or one near-white frame); a tagline recedes and fades in 3 frames; the last word shrinks and dims like it is moving away.
techniques.recipe: Words exit 'launch' on scale (or a camera push-out on E.buildIn) cut on its last frame. Anatomy: Scale 1 -> 0.85-0.9 accelerating; dim 30 % on a decrescendo. Sound: A cut on the voice phrase; a boom or reverse on the decrescendo.
techniques.timing: 20-40 f; 14 px/f at the cut.
techniques.use_when: Text cards between scenes; the last word of a section.
techniques.avoid_when: Shrinking toward zero (stop at 0.85-0.9 and cut).

techniques.name: Handwritten line writes on at pen speed
techniques.summary: A monoline handwritten signature draws left to right at a constant pen speed on a card; it can write twice as cards swap.
techniques.recipe: SVG path with stroke-dashoffset from strokeDrawn() (65 px a frame at 60 fps) or a linear tween. Anatomy: One SVG stroke, dash offset at constant speed. Sound: A soft pen scratch.
techniques.timing: 52-67 f linear per write; card swap 37 f overlapping by 12 f.
techniques.use_when: Personal, signed, approved moments.
techniques.avoid_when: Fonts pretending to be handwriting.

techniques.name: Pre-centred words switch on every two frames
techniques.summary: Words appear in one frame each, at full ink, in the slots of a line that is already laid out and centred, one every 2 frames (12 words a second); they can be erased in the same order.
techniques.recipe: <Words dur={1} rise={0} stagger={5}> (Words lays out the final centred line); erase with exit 'words' at 5 f; hit captions are HardStep on/off frames. Anatomy: Final layout solved first, words cut on in reading order, no fade, no scale; variants: huge left-aligned words (66 % of the frame width, 190 px tall) on the accent field; 10-frame steps for a slow caption; hit captions held 12-25 f and cut off in one frame. Sound: The completed phrase lands on a kick; hit captions sit on hits or in a stop-down silence.
techniques.timing: 5 f at 60 fps per word (2 f at 24-30 fps); erase 5 f apart in the same order; slow version 10 f per word; hit captions hold 30-60 f.
techniques.use_when: A fast opener, a title that rides a camera move, hit captions over footage, huge words on a full accent field.
techniques.avoid_when: Calm films; lines longer than 5 words (the build becomes a flicker).

techniques.name: Only the last word swaps
techniques.summary: A held line keeps its start and swaps only its last word, several times ("for writers / editors / teams"): the outgoing word heats in colour while the line creeps, the swap lands with two big frames and a settle; small camera nudges alternate direction with each swap.
techniques.recipe: <LineSnap mode="room"> for the creep-jump plus a slot that HardSteps the word; colour heat via HueSweep back. Anatomy: Creep 1, 2, 6 px/f; swap; two big frames; settle; variant: the last word rolls vertically while gap tiles turn into icons. Sound: Voice.
techniques.timing: Swap 20-30 f; nudges 26-32 f in-out; roll 8 f.
techniques.use_when: Listing audiences, use cases or outcomes in one held sentence.
techniques.avoid_when: More than three or four swaps.

techniques.name: Line written on behind a soft moving edge
techniques.summary: A line is revealed left to right by a travelling edge about one letter soft, near-constant speed, so it writes on; glyphs can be born in a hot accent and cool; a status line can end with a spinner turning into a check.
techniques.recipe: <Wipe kind="gradient" feather={about 1.1 em in px} span={the line's width}> on the line (give the edge: the gradient's house edge, 0.7 of the span, is the long ramp); accent via HueSweep or Words accent. Anatomy: an alpha edge of about 1 em (1.2 em at most) and the letters behind it at full strength; glyphs accent -> ink as the edge passes. A long ramp from the ink into the ground (a third of the line or more) reads as half-faded words, never as writing. Sound: a soft notification ding mid-reveal, or a kick at the end. As one line: the TypeLine preset `develop` (a 1.1 em edge in the tint, then the accent and the ink).
techniques.timing: 6-24 f across 880 px (first 4 f slower); fall-off 56 f.
techniques.use_when: Status lines, single lines over a picture.
techniques.avoid_when: Edges narrower than a letter (that reads as a hard wipe); edges wider than a word (fade soup); a hero line.

techniques.name: Word cuts on touching, then the space opens
techniques.summary: Each appended word cuts on with no word space (the line reads run-together for a frame or two), then the spaces open and the line re-centres: the word visibly docks.
techniques.recipe: <Chain recentre="jump"> with a word-space tween from 0 to the font space over 8 f (letter-spacing on the gap span). Recipe: each word's margin-left = space x k with k 0 -> 1 over 12 f (cubic out); negative start values give the overlap version. Anatomy: Spaces open over 3-4 f; re-centre 65-68 % in the first frame, x0.7 a frame after. Sound: One soft tick per word (±45 ms). Materials: Tight append: the new word lands touching the previous one (zero word space, or even overlapping it when it flies in large, glyphs compositing darker where they cross); over the next 8-16 f only the newcomer slides right and the normal space opens on an ease-out while earlier words stay put (left-aligned lines), or the line re-centres once the colour has cooled from the accent to ink. As one line: `<TypeLine spec={{ preset: 'open', text, at }}>` (each word soft for its first frames and in the accent, the space opening in 7 f, the line re-centring on E.jump with a trail).
techniques.timing: Spaces 7-8 f; re-centre about 24 f.
techniques.use_when: Taglines built word by word; a brand line.
techniques.avoid_when: Long words that become unreadable when run together.
techniques.materials: Tight append: the new word lands touching the previous one (zero word space, or even overlapping it when it flies in large, glyphs compositing darker where they cross); over the next 8-16 f only the newcomer slides right and the normal space opens on an ease-out while earlier words stay put (left-aligned lines), or the line re-centres once the colour has cooled from the accent to ink.

techniques.name: Word halves slide out from behind a plate
techniques.summary: The two halves of one word emerge from under a plate (masked by it) and drift outward, the word opening around the object.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: two Words spans inside a clip-path that excludes the plate, translated outward on E.snapOut. Anatomy: Two halves clipped by the plate's edge, drifting apart. Sound: None.
techniques.timing: 40 f ease-out.
techniques.use_when: A word that wraps a product or a dock.
techniques.avoid_when: Words that split badly.

techniques.name: Caption resolves out of a light streak
techniques.summary: The next caption first exists as a thin bright horizontal streak (letters unreadable), widens, turns into a heavily smeared word, then snaps sharp: the caption is born from light rather than faded in. The exit is the same device reversed: the caption dims, gains a horizontal ghost and collapses into a wide bright streak (or a thin grey line) that vanishes.
techniques.recipe: Build: <StreakResolve at text x y font light> (fx/Streak): the caption through a heavy sideways blur squeezed to a hairline with a bright core, opening over the first half of 15 f on E.whipBuild (width 0.89 -> 1.03 of the caption, height to the line: measured), then the word smeared sideways for 5 f, then sharp, one sample a frame; exit={{ at }} dims to 40 %, ghosts, and collapses into a widening streak on twos (18 f). Anatomy: Stage 1 streak (a 1-4 px tall bar, 200-660 px wide, front-loaded widening), stage 2 a horizontally smeared word for 2 f, stage 3 sharp. Variant: the smear grows rightward out of the previous word on twos, then a 2-frame scramble, then sharp. Exit: dim to 40 %, ghost, collapse to a 330-600 px streak on twos, accelerating. Sound: No hit of its own; it rides the voice onset. Materials: Relay construction: the outgoing caption gets a trailing ghost (4 f), blurs sideways into a doubled bar (4 f), becomes a bright horizontal streak about 1100 px wide with a fainter offset copy (+40, +12 px at 35 %) for 6 f, breaks for one frame into blocky glyph fragments (a decode) and lands sharp as the next caption; on twos except the decode frame.
techniques.timing: Streak 3-15 f, smear 5 f, sharp: 8-20 f in all, stepped, front-loaded; the caption leads the spoken word by 2-16 f.
techniques.use_when: Voice-led films where captions follow the narration; the first caption after a section break; a word that grows out of the one before it.
techniques.avoid_when: Long lines; anything that must be read on its first frames.
techniques.materials: Relay construction: the outgoing caption gets a trailing ghost (4 f), blurs sideways into a doubled bar (4 f), becomes a bright horizontal streak about 1100 px wide with a fainter offset copy (+40, +12 px at 35 %) for 6 f, breaks for one frame into blocky glyph fragments (a decode) and lands sharp as the next caption; on twos except the decode frame.

techniques.name: Type cut into strips that slide apart
techniques.summary: A number and a word are cut into horizontal strips (8-10 per glyph) that slide sideways at different offsets until they span the full width.
techniques.recipe: Build: <Slices kind="strips" at x y w h n={9}>{type}</Slices> (fx/Slices): each strip a clipped copy sliding sideways by a seeded share of the frame width on E.jump (spread by 3 f at 24 fps; 43 f); back={{ at }} gathers them. Anatomy: Strips with seeded offsets, expanding sideways; full width by 3 frames in. Sound: None needed.
techniques.use_when: A big number becoming a field; a transition out of a stat.
techniques.avoid_when: Text that must stay readable.

techniques.name: Taglines swap on the second with a small pop
techniques.summary: Small taglines replace each other exactly every second; the new one appears slightly small and pops to size in 2 frames while its contrast rises.
techniques.recipe: HardStep swaps every 60 f; scale via a 2 f tween; opacity contrast over 20 f. Anatomy: Hard swap; scale 0.88 -> 1 in 2 f; contrast up over 16-28 f. Sound: On round seconds, not on beats.
techniques.timing: Every 60 f; pop 2 f.
techniques.use_when: A run of short claims over a photo.
techniques.avoid_when: More than about four swaps.

techniques.name: Line moves through: arrive, drift, leave as one move
techniques.summary: A line enters already moving (77 px/f) and decelerating, drifts at a constant slow speed while it is read, and leaves on an expo-in: one continuous move, never parked; a card can shrink fast-slow-fast and cut at the fastest point; a label can recede steadily like it is moving away; the frame can contract a few px a side during a silent hold.
techniques.recipe: Words (rise from the side) + a drift transform + exit 'launch'. Anatomy: Expo-out arrival, linear drift (0.3 %/f or a few px/f), expo-in exit; a receding label shrinks to 0.59x over 2 s. Sound: A sub-bass hit on the arrival; silence under the contraction.
techniques.timing: Arrival 20-30 f, drift for the read, exit 14-20 f.
techniques.use_when: Openers, statements between scenes, loops (elements already moving on the first frame).
techniques.avoid_when: Parking the line between its entrance and exit.

techniques.name: Ticker words slam in, old words cut off the edge
techniques.summary: Each new word enters from the right with a huge first-frame jump (135-290 px) and an expo tail; the older words are pushed left and cut off by the frame.
techniques.recipe: <Chain recentre="jump" ink="pop" edgeMask={{ left: 0 }}> with the line anchored right. Anatomy: Jump frame + tail per word, the line shifts by the new word's width; exits on single frames at the left edge. Sound: A hit per word.
techniques.timing: 2 f jump + 12 f tail per word.
techniques.use_when: A rapid list of verbs or features on hits.
techniques.avoid_when: Copy that must be read in full.

techniques.name: A label rises in gradient ink, then a blink wave turns it white
techniques.summary: A small label rises from a baseline mask filled with the same gradient as the card behind it, so it is almost camouflaged; then a wave passes left to right: each letter blinks out for a few frames and comes back pure white, so for a moment the word reads white, gap, tinted.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: MaskRise for the rise, then per-letter spans whose fill switches from the gradient clip to white after a 4 f dropout. Anatomy: Rise 12 f; tinted hold 16 f (text clipped to the card's gradient at about 0.8); dropout wave about 4 f apart per letter, each letter off for 4 f, then white. Sound: A soft tick per letter, or none.
techniques.timing: About 76 f in all.
techniques.use_when: A label on a gradient or tinted card; a product name inside a UI card.
techniques.avoid_when: Long copy; plain grounds (the camouflage needs the gradient behind).

techniques.name: Letter spacing snaps to normal
techniques.summary: A word appears too tight (letters overlapping) or too loose and snaps or tracks in to its normal spacing.
techniques.recipe: <Letters tracking> (house +0.024 em closing over 20 f) or Wordmark trackingState. Anatomy: Tracking from 78-83 % or 102-128 % of the word's width to 100 %, on 16 fps steps or an ease-out. Sound: The hard cut.
techniques.timing: 8-15 f on steps; a slow track-in 20 f.
techniques.use_when: Words on cards in a fast cut sequence; a small subtitle settling under a figure.
techniques.avoid_when: Long sentences.

techniques.name: Two type voices with fixed jobs
techniques.summary: A film gives two faces two jobs: statements in a high-contrast display face, UI in a small grotesk; a wide bold title face for one act and a light weight for the next; big caps with a tiny connector word between them.
techniques.recipe: Two font roles in brand/tokens; Words for statements, kit Text for UI. Anatomy: Size contrast 3-5x between the voices; the display face never appears inside UI. Sound: None.
techniques.timing: Static choice; the connector word can type while the caps fade.
techniques.use_when: Editorial launches; films with an act structure.
techniques.avoid_when: More than two voices; a second face that fights the brand.
techniques.ban_safe_variant: Two weights and widths of the brand family (heavy display, light UI).

techniques.name: Typeface cycles while the line steps larger
techniques.summary: Every 3 frames the typeface of a title swaps (serif, mono, light grotesk, heavy), while the line steps larger; it lands on the brand face.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: an array of font stacks indexed by a stepped frame inside <Stepped fps={8}>, measured under FontGate so each swap re-centres. Anatomy: Hard swaps of the face, the line re-centred each swap, scale stepping up. Sound: None needed; or a tick per swap. Materials: Only the brand word shuffles through font styles every 4-6 f (regular, black, thin extended, black extended, back to regular) while the rest of the line stays still; cap height constant, the extended styles pushing the word about 25 % wider. With a variable font this is a wght and wdth change per state; the house bans italic, so leave the slant axis out.
techniques.timing: 8 swaps a second (every 7-8 f); 38 f in all.
techniques.use_when: A launch about type, image or style; a title once.
techniques.avoid_when: Any film whose brand face must be respected from the first frame.
techniques.materials: Only the brand word shuffles through font styles every 4-6 f (regular, black, thin extended, black extended, back to regular) while the rest of the line stays still; cap height constant, the extended styles pushing the word about 25 % wider. With a variable font this is a wght and wdth change per state; the house bans italic, so leave the slant axis out.
techniques.ban_safe_variant: Cycle between weights and widths of the brand family only.

techniques.name: Typing with an accent trail on the newest characters
techniques.summary: While text types or streams, its newest characters (or words) wear the accent and age to ink behind the caret: a colour trail that shows where the writing is.
techniques.recipe: <TypeOn kind="human"|"stream" trail={{ color: C.accent, chars: 10 }}>; a mention is a span with its own colour. Anatomy: Trail of 6-12 characters (about 600 px) fading accent -> ink; variants: the last 2-4 characters grey on a pale highlight block (typing in word bursts); a streamed answer with a grey leading tail; a mention token that types in its own colour and keeps it; a pink caret matching the trail. Sound: Keypress ticks for a person; none for a machine stream; a chat pop when a mention completes. Materials: A colour wave runs through the typed answer behind the caret: once about 8 characters exist a band about 5 characters wide (the accent at the centre, soft to white over 2 characters each side) starts at the first letter and travels more slowly than the typing (0.75 of its speed), so it ends after the typing does.
techniques.timing: 24-90 characters a second; word bursts every 6 f; streams at about 30 words a second; trail ages over 10 characters.
techniques.use_when: Prompts, AI answers, streamed replies, any product typing.
techniques.avoid_when: Two accents at once; trails longer than about 12 characters.
techniques.materials: A colour wave runs through the typed answer behind the caret: once about 8 characters exist a band about 5 characters wide (the accent at the centre, soft to white over 2 characters each side) starts at the first letter and travels more slowly than the typing (0.75 of its speed), so it ends after the typing does.

techniques.name: Typewriter on an ease-out progress
techniques.summary: A line types at full opacity, character-quantised but on an ease-out: 41 % of its width after one frame, 66 % after two, then slowing; contrasting accent words type in the same pass.
techniques.recipe: <TypeOn kind="stream" ease={E.snapOut}>. Anatomy: Character count follows an ease-out; accent words in a contrasting face inline. Sound: Voice.
techniques.timing: 54 f at 60 fps.
techniques.use_when: A line that should feel written in one stroke.
techniques.avoid_when: Prompts (people do not type on an ease).

techniques.name: Typing whose newest characters arrive smeared
techniques.summary: Text types fast while its newest 2-30 characters arrive as a horizontal smear (or a soft accent ghost running ahead of the white text) that sharpens behind the caret: speed you can see.
techniques.recipe: TypeOn kind 'stream' or 'prompt' plus a smear window: draw the last n characters a second time through a fixed horizontal-blur copy (the trail prop gives the colour half of it). Anatomy: Committed text sharp; a trailing window of the last 2-3 characters (or a 10-30 character ghost in the accent ahead of the text) with horizontal blur; typing in bursts. Sound: Keypress ticks only when the typing is slow enough to hear; a fast run takes none.
techniques.timing: 60-130 characters a second (1 char a frame at 60 fps); each character sharpens over 6 f; bursts over 22-34 f.
techniques.use_when: A prompt or URL typed fast into the product, especially just before a cut hides the end of the sentence.
techniques.avoid_when: Slow, readable typing (the smear then looks like a rendering fault).

techniques.name: Word shown first as a block of its own size
techniques.summary: Each word first appears as a solid colour block exactly its size, then becomes the word, which drops 25 px onto the baseline; blocks can rotate through the accents' tints.
techniques.recipe: BlockStep silhouette per word (the incoming element's flat silhouette steps to the real word), or HardStep on/off frames with a rect of the measured word box. Anatomy: Block (the word's box, one colour, 3 f) -> word; alternate words rise or drop; 1-2 words per step. Sound: Voice words; a ding on the line's completion.
techniques.timing: 4 f per word at 60 fps; block 6 f; 4-5 f per word in a run.
techniques.use_when: A voice-led headline in a bold, graphic film.
techniques.avoid_when: Calm films; more than one line.

techniques.name: Fade-and-rise word, front-loaded
techniques.summary: The default way a word arrives: it is already a third visible on its first frame and rises a third of its line box as it fades, so it reads as present at once and lands softly.
techniques.recipe: <Words> at house numbers (dur 32, rise 0.33 line, stagger 12, cadence 'reading'); a drop uses riseDir up with a 2-frame vertical ghost; a diagonal entry offsets x by 1.2x the rise. Anatomy: One tween per word on opacity (from about 35 %) and y (0.2-0.8 em, house 0.33 line box). Variants: a drop from above with a short vertical smear for an energetic headline; a diagonal entry (from 54 px low and 68 px right) for a new line that rides a camera move; a second word starting one frame after the first on the same curve so a two-word opener reads as one object. Sound: Words sit on voice onsets; with no voice, one soft tick per fragment on the last word's landing, never one per word. Materials: Floor-reflection variant: each word rises into place trailing a faded, vertically flipped copy under it (blur 1 px, 40 % decaying to 0 in 8 f) as if it rose out of a glossy floor, the word itself going from 50 to 100 % white.
techniques.timing: Fade 32 f on a steep ease-out (50 % at 10 % of the time, 90 % by 15 f), rise 22-25 f. Stagger 8-14 f on a reading cadence; 2 f for a two-word opener; 8-14 f for a voice-clocked caption. Travel 23-77 px at 1080p.
techniques.use_when: Any calm statement, voice-clocked captions, the body copy of a launch or update film.
techniques.avoid_when: A beat that needs a hit (use a pop or an oversized landing), or a line already moving with the camera.
techniques.materials: Floor-reflection variant: each word rises into place trailing a faded, vertically flipped copy under it (blur 1 px, 40 % decaying to 0 in 8 f) as if it rose out of a glossy floor, the word itself going from 50 to 100 % white.

techniques.name: Agent step list: spinner rows that tick to checks
techniques.summary: The product shows its work as a list of steps: each row starts with a small spinner (a dashed ring or an arc) and its words step in at partial ink, then the line fades up and the spinner turns into a check; rows cut on with a coloured verb that drains to ink as the next row arrives; the list jumps up a row (or half a row) unanimated, or pushes up in 3-frame expo steps; the cadence of rows shortens toward the end (9, 9, 7, 5, 4, 3, 3 f).
techniques.recipe: Build: <StepList rows={stepCadence(start, n).map((at) => ({ at }))} labels x y width font colors> (fx/Loaders): rows cut on with a spinner (120 deg per 3 f at 30 fps) and the verb in the accent at 45 % ink, the line fades up (14 f), the spinner swaps to a check (3 f) and the verb drains to ink as the next row arrives (6 f); the list jumps a row unanimated past window (or jump="expo"); house cadence 18, 18, 14, 10, 8, 6, 6 f. Anatomy: Row = spinner + verb (accent tint) + grey detail + optional right icon; thin thread line on the left; status line eases down 12 px before a new row (anticipation); list jump 93-94 px in one frame. Sound: Rows within 60 ms of wood-block or drum hits; dings on rows; a glockenspiel on the last. Materials: Each step's icon draws itself: a short arc grows clockwise to about 270 deg and closes into a circle (12 f), the check draws in 4 f; icon 16 px, stroke 1.5 px in the row's current colour; the row text walks through a short hue path to ink as it completes (28-44 f), or each verb takes its own pastel tint and slides in 10 px over 16 f before cooling to white; a 2 px guide line pre-draws down the left 12 f before the first row; pending steps stay a dashed ring of 8 dashes.
techniques.timing: Rows every 14-50 f (shortening); spinner about 120 deg per 3 f; check swap 2-4 f; line fade 12-16 f; verb drain 4-6 f.
techniques.use_when: AI agents, builds, workflows, any "it is doing it" moment.
techniques.avoid_when: Smooth scrolling lists (the steps should feel like software); more than about seven rows.
techniques.materials: Each step's icon draws itself: a short arc grows clockwise to about 270 deg and closes into a circle (12 f), the check draws in 4 f; icon 16 px, stroke 1.5 px in the row's current colour; the row text walks through a short hue path to ink as it completes (28-44 f), or each verb takes its own pastel tint and slides in 10 px over 16 f before cooling to white; a 2 px guide line pre-draws down the left 12 f before the first row; pending steps stay a dashed ring of 8 dashes.

techniques.name: Avatar bubbles swoop, orbit and split
