techniques.summary: Round avatar bubbles behave like characters: one swoops in on an arc from an impact point and drifts; two orbit around their midpoint and swap sides while one splits into a group; a smaller bubble is ejected from a group bubble on an arc and grows.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: polar paths in closed form (angle on an ease, radius on its own curve); the split is a MorphChain swap at mid-orbit. Anatomy: Arc paths (peak 137 px/f), orbit 154 deg (peak 13.4 deg/f), growth +30 % mid-swap, ejection r 87 -> 164 px in 8 f. Sound: A UI pop on arrival; voice. Materials: A bubble first appears as an empty glass ring (rim 4-6 px, a gradient from the tint to white, an inner radial gradient from a white centre to the tint at the edge, a specular dot low right), then its glyph rises from the lower edge into place clipped by the ring (8-10 f, expo-out); the next bubble repeats it 18 f later.
techniques.timing: Swoop 75-85 f; orbit 90 f; ejection 20 f.
techniques.use_when: Collaboration and people features.
techniques.avoid_when: More than three bubbles.
techniques.materials: A bubble first appears as an empty glass ring (rim 4-6 px, a gradient from the tint to white, an inner radial gradient from a white centre to the tint at the edge, a specular dot low right), then its glyph rises from the lower edge into place clipped by the ring (8-10 f, expo-out); the next bubble repeats it 18 f later.
conditions: gradients baked as dithered plates and moved by transform

techniques.name: Cards fan out from behind into a stack
techniques.summary: Copies of a card slide out from behind the front card 2 f apart into a tilted stack or a cover-flow fan; sibling cards enter from opposite sides with faint ghost trails; the stack collapses back behind the front card on exit.
techniques.recipe: Cards cardArrive per copy with delays 4 f and demote for the front card's lift. Anatomy: Followers 2 f apart, spreading on an ease-in to 42 px/f then a settle push x1.08; hero card lifts x1.25 while the fan spreads; tilt 2-8 deg; collapse on an ease-in. Sound: A pop on the spread; a whoosh series on the collapse. Materials: Before the back cards fan out, 1-3 hairline card edges appear one by one at the side of the single front card (one more every 4 f, a 1 px rim at 18 % white), so the viewer senses the stack before it opens.
techniques.timing: Spread 20 f; settle 16 f; siblings 40 f apart; collapse 22 f.
techniques.use_when: Plans, sources, payments, posters: several of one kind.
techniques.avoid_when: More than about five cards.
techniques.materials: Before the back cards fan out, 1-3 hairline card edges appear one by one at the side of the single front card (one more every 4 f, a 1 px rim at 18 % white), so the viewer senses the stack before it opens.

techniques.name: Cards flick onto a pile
techniques.summary: New photo cards pop onto the top of a fanned stack one after another, each starting small and motion-blurred, the cadence decaying until the cut; inside a framed screen, cards spin in toward level, pile up and orbit as a ring.
techniques.recipe: Cards cardArrive (rot, scale from 0.7) with starts on a decaying list. Anatomy: Arrival 6 f each; one card every 9-10 f, decaying; spin 10 f; orbit 100 f in two pushes. Sound: A beat bed; a wood-block hit. Materials: A new card is born inside the face of the current top card: small (35 % of a card) and heavily blurred (20 px for 2-4 f) over its right half, it grows and turns toward the viewer (yaw 15 -> 5 deg in perspective) and lands as the new top card with a soft drop shadow appearing; about 12 f per card, one every 24 f.
techniques.use_when: Accumulation: saves, uploads, picks.
techniques.avoid_when: Even cadence.
techniques.materials: A new card is born inside the face of the current top card: small (35 % of a card) and heavily blurred (20 px for 2-4 f) over its right half, it grows and turns toward the viewer (yaw 15 -> 5 deg in perspective) and lands as the new top card with a soft drop shadow appearing; about 12 f per card, one every 24 f.

techniques.name: Card scales in, creeps, then pushes into the cut
techniques.summary: A card or dialog grows from 70-90 % (often blurred or smeared on its first frame) to full size with 90 % of the change in about 8 f, keeps a slow creep, then accelerates into the cut; a dock can expand out of a split line.
techniques.recipe: Cards enterState with scale from 0.85 + creep + scaleBreath into the cut. Anatomy: Scale 0.7-0.89 -> 1 expo-out, a 0.05 %/f creep or 1.8 px/f growth, quad-in push into the cut; optional relax of 0.8 % after the overshoot-free landing; content swaps 1 f. Sound: The cut on frame 1; none on the push.
techniques.timing: In 12-65 f; creep for the hold; push 32 f.
techniques.use_when: Hero cards, export dialogs, posts, chat windows.
techniques.avoid_when: Growing from zero.

techniques.name: Carousel: fast in, near stop, fast out
techniques.summary: A row of cards slides through: fast on entry, decaying almost to zero for the read, then accelerating before the cut, with soft faded edges; status chips can swap spinner to done left to right as it passes; or the row moves in discrete pushes as each new card lands.
techniques.recipe: A camera x with E.snapOut entry and E.launchIn exit; edgeMask for the faded edges; HardStep pushes for the discrete variant. Anatomy: Entry 81 px/f decaying to a 7.3 px/f cruise, exit to 31 px/f; discrete variant: pushes of 40-200 px per frame every 2-4 f. Sound: A whoosh on the exit.
techniques.timing: 100-160 f; chip swaps 35 f apart.
techniques.use_when: Examples, creators, thumbnails, results.
techniques.avoid_when: Constant speed.

techniques.name: Chips fall like objects and float back
techniques.summary: When the line says "disconnected", the chips around it fall like objects (accelerating), land in a cluster at the bottom and straighten as they land, then drift back up; after popping, chips can float upward on a very long tail.
techniques.recipe: Build: gravityDrop(f, { at, fall, rot, drift }) (fx/Flight): the fall on E.buildIn (24 f), the rotation flattening over the last 30 %, then a slow drift back up (2.5 px/f at 60). Anatomy: Fall 7 -> 67 px/f, rotation flattening on landing, drift back -5 px/f; float 220 px on a long expo-out still moving 3 px/f at the end. Sound: Camera-shutter clicks and bubble pops.
techniques.timing: Fall 24 f; float 68 f (t90 1.13 s).
techniques.use_when: Showing disorder or separation with UI chips.
techniques.avoid_when: Bounces (land, do not bounce).

techniques.name: Chosen item enlarges while the rest dissolve
techniques.summary: From a menu or a row of cards, the camera zooms into the chosen one (or it scales up 0.78 -> 1.0) while the others blur and fade into the background.
techniques.recipe: SnapZoom or Cards enterState on the chosen item; RackFocus levels on the rest. Anatomy: Chosen: expo-out scale or zoom; others: blur and fade over 14-16 f. Sound: A kick or a beat on the choice.
techniques.timing: Zoom 32-40 f; others 14-16 f.
techniques.use_when: Selecting a product, a plan, a result.
techniques.avoid_when: Keeping the others sharp.

techniques.name: Tile slides out to clear a slot for the next actor
techniques.summary: A tile slides out on an in-out curve leaving a stub, and the next actor (a cursor, a tile) enters the vacated space 2 f before it settles; a secondary tile shift overlaps the previous move by 11 f.
techniques.recipe: Cards enterState out on E.strongInOut; the next actor starting 4 f before the end. Anatomy: Quart in-out, peak 91-117 px/f, no blur; overlap 11 f. Sound: None.
techniques.use_when: Making space inside a bento or layout for a demo action.
techniques.avoid_when: Moves that end before the next one starts (overlap them).

techniques.name: Card streams on conveyors with U-shaped speed
techniques.summary: Streams of image cards travel on diagonals (one up-right, one down-left) or in rows with fade masks at the edges, fast on entry, slow in the middle, fast on exit; a photo strip accelerates to a whip and slows while the tiles grow so the hero ends large; two rivers of cards accelerate six-fold into a full blur and cut.
techniques.recipe: Build: <Conveyor start n pitch angle x y render={(i) => card}> (fx/Conveyor): a looped stream whose speed enters at 65 px/f, settles to 18 (56 f), and with outAt grows 6x into the cut (28 f, 64 % of the change in the last fifth); two conveyors at opposite angles with a phase offset make the rivers; edges fade by mask; declares() marks the fast frames as camera blur. Anatomy: Rounded cards about 140 px; diagonal angle about 44 deg; edge fade masks; speed U-curve; growth toward the hero. Sound: Enters on a swap; exits with the word; a cut +120 ms after the beat. Materials: Rivers get depth per card, not one flat speed blur: neighbours at the same 8-9 px/f are blurred by different seeded amounts (0 or 6-10 px), lean 3-8 deg in perspective and scale down slightly with depth; card radius about 24 px, shadow 0 10px 20px at 10 %. A collage conveyor can magnify while it pans (1 -> 3.2x over 150 f, ease-in) while its content turns from one mood to its opposite, slowing almost to rest for 60 f at the peak so the faces can be read.
techniques.timing: In 56 f, cruise, out 28 f; a rush into blur 60 f (64 % of the change in the last 20 %).
techniques.use_when: Showing volume (thousands of images, many creators, a feed of examples).
techniques.avoid_when: Constant-speed marquees.
techniques.materials: Rivers get depth per card, not one flat speed blur: neighbours at the same 8-9 px/f are blurred by different seeded amounts (0 or 6-10 px), lean 3-8 deg in perspective and scale down slightly with depth; card radius about 24 px, shadow 0 10px 20px at 10 %. A collage conveyor can magnify while it pans (1 -> 3.2x over 150 f, ease-in) while its content turns from one mood to its opposite, slowing almost to rest for 60 f at the peak so the faces can be read.

techniques.name: Tilted page sweeps up, develops colour, is scrolled
techniques.summary: A white product page tilted in perspective sweeps up from the bottom in a few frames, its illustration develops from ghost grey through a tint to full colour, and the camera scrolls it in three moves.
techniques.recipe: Cards enterState (lean 20) + Develop + reframeChain. Anatomy: Sweep 12 f; develop grey -> tint -> colour; three scroll moves. Sound: A spoken word, then a punchy hit.
techniques.timing: 256 f in all.
techniques.use_when: A product page or a landing page shown as an object.
techniques.avoid_when: Flat, untilted pages (they read as screenshots).

techniques.name: Field fills a word at a time, each word lit for one frame
techniques.summary: A query field fills one whole word every 2 frames, each new word in the accent for exactly one frame; a prompt card can fill one line per frame.
techniques.recipe: <TypeOn kind="field" accent>. Anatomy: Words cut on whole; one-frame accent flash per word; variant: a 3-line prompt in 3 frames. Sound: Typing ticks or a bubble pop when the card completes.
techniques.timing: 12 words a second (one every 5 f at 60 fps); a line per frame for a prompt card.
techniques.use_when: Showing that the product understands a request instantly; a montage of prompts.
techniques.avoid_when: Text the viewer must read word by word.

techniques.name: Flick scroll: ramp, peak, friction
techniques.summary: Content accelerates by a constant ratio a frame into a peak, brakes on friction and lands; an exit whip can hand straight into the scroll; a column of cards decays from 68 px/f to a 2 px/f drift; the input bar decelerates into place as the conversation stops.
techniques.recipe: flickState({ ramp, peak, brake, distance }); declares the fast frames as a camera-blur range. Anatomy: Ramp x1.05-1.1 a frame to 176 px/f, friction x0.955 a frame (or x0.77 -> 0.85), brake time constant 0.73 s. Sound: A sub-bass drop on the peak speed; a stab on the landing.
techniques.timing: Exit 20 f; scroll 70-250 f.
techniques.use_when: Feeds, lists, long conversations.
techniques.avoid_when: Even-speed scrolling.

techniques.name: Grid assembles cell by cell
techniques.summary: Outlined cards with logos slide into a grid with irregular stagger (one card snapping 880 px in a single frame); grid cells fill with blank tiles, then their text lines and progress bars fill in; rows of squares are born below and the block re-centres every frame.
techniques.recipe: Cards enterState per cell with seeded delays; HardStep for the snapping card. Anatomy: Stagger 1-8 f; slides 24 f; one-frame snap; blank card 3-4 f then content 4-8 f; squares grow 33 -> 82 px. Sound: Bubble pops; a pop per row.
techniques.timing: 28-74 f; rows every 2 f.
techniques.use_when: Integrations, sponsors, a dashboard filling up.
techniques.avoid_when: Perfectly even stagger.

techniques.name: Inner UI pops in, left to right or top to bottom
techniques.summary: Inside a panel that has landed, chips, cards, a stat ring and buttons pop in with a 2 f stagger; agent log rows fade in one by one while the list scrolls; or the card stays and its content changes (the title retypes, the subtitle soft-reveals, the footer blurs away).
techniques.recipe: Cards / kit parts with starts every 4 f; TypeOn for the retype; Wipe gradient for the soft reveal. Anatomy: Stagger 2-5 f, short fades; a retype at 5-6 chars/f. Sound: UI ticks. Materials: Window chrome fills in item by item after the window lands: icon, then its label 6 f later (fade 4-6 f), header label 8 f after the landing, a chevron dropping 14 px in 6 f, a menu icon 10 f later; a footer row of icons pops in three stages over 8 f.
techniques.timing: 24 f for a panel; rows 6-10 f apart.
techniques.use_when: Filling a panel after it lands.
techniques.avoid_when: Filling before the panel has settled.
techniques.materials: Window chrome fills in item by item after the window lands: icon, then its label 6 f later (fade 4-6 f), header label 8 f after the landing, a chevron dropping 14 px in 6 f, a menu icon 10 f later; a footer row of icons pops in three stages over 8 f.

techniques.name: Code types in plain ink; syntax colours arrive a few frames later
techniques.summary: A code snippet types line by line in plain dark monospace; a few frames after each token is complete its syntax colour switches on (placeholders and string values flip from ink to the accent), as if the editor were catching up.
techniques.recipe: Recipe: TypeOn over tokenised code; a token takes its colour once the frame is 10 f past its completion. Anatomy: Mono about 14 px at 1080p, line height 1.6; the colour about 10 f after the token completes; the accent only on placeholders and strings. Sound: Key ticks under the VO.
techniques.timing: About 55 f of typing for a short snippet; recolours staggered with the tokens.
techniques.use_when: SDK, API and developer products; any code card.
techniques.avoid_when: Fast walls of code, where the delay cannot be read.

techniques.name: Card lands by shrinking to size
techniques.summary: A notification, a widget or a hero card appears a little large (1.07-1.22x) and settles down to size while it sharpens; dashboard widgets can cut on every 4 f at 107 % and settle in 5 f; a full-frame photo can shrink 20 % into a card.
techniques.recipe: <Oversize from={1.12} dur={16}> or Words oversize on UI; widgets with starts every 8 f. Anatomy: Scale-down landing, defocus clearing; per-widget cut-ons on a fixed cadence. Sound: A whoosh tail; cork-like pops on the photo shrink. Materials: The result card's paragraph fades out line by line toward its end, as if still streaming (a vertical mask from opaque at 45 % to transparent), and a thin two-hue gradient rule echoing the ground separates it from the footer chips.
techniques.timing: 10-38 f expo-out (47 % in 10 %); widgets 8 f apart, 10 f settle.
techniques.use_when: Notifications, dashboards, cards that land on a beat.
techniques.avoid_when: Overshooting below size.
techniques.materials: The result card's paragraph fades out line by line toward its end, as if still streaming (a vertical mask from opaque at 45 % to transparent), and a thin two-hue gradient rule echoing the ground separates it from the footer chips.
conditions: gradients baked as dithered plates and moved by transform

techniques.name: Words added into a pill that resizes instantly
techniques.summary: Words appear one at a time inside a pill and the pill takes its new width in one frame each time, with uneven gaps that feel like thinking.
techniques.recipe: <HardStep> snapBox of the measured text widths; words pop. Anatomy: Pill width = snapBox of the text width; words cut on. Sound: None, or a soft tick per word.
techniques.timing: Word gaps 15, 33, 8 f (uneven).
techniques.use_when: A prompt or idea being formed; a chip that grows.
techniques.avoid_when: Eased container growth next to it (keep it hard).

techniques.name: Cards fly in radially on one ease
techniques.summary: Seven small tilted UI cards (lists, notes, charts, messages) fly in radially from off-screen on one shared exponential ease and settle around the centre, their rotation tails running long.
techniques.recipe: Cards cardArrive per card on one curve with radial from vectors and rot 8-35 deg. Anatomy: Shared curve, per-card direction and tilt; rotation settles last. Sound: Voice.
techniques.timing: Each visible 28-48 f; rotation tail 120 f.
techniques.use_when: Showing many parts of a product at once around a statement.
techniques.avoid_when: Cards with readable detail (they are too small to read).

techniques.name: Resize: small creep, one big jump, long settle
techniques.summary: A card or field is resized the way a tool resizes it: a short anticipation creep, one big jump frame (50-70 % of the change) with stretched echo handles, then a long settle; an emptied field stretches with a slow-in, a 3-frame lunge and a long tail while the caret glides.
techniques.recipe: Build: <ResizeBox at from to handle line radius>{content}</ResizeBox> (fx/Resize): creep 15 % over 12 f (E.softIn), ONE jump frame of 60 % with the corner handles stretched back as echo bars, then an exponential settle (24 f); jumpFrames={3} is the field version (a three-frame lunge). Anatomy: Creep under 20 % over 4-6 f; jump 1 f; settle 8-10 f; handles stretch toward the new edge on the jump frame and snap back. Sound: The jump on a snare (+5 ms); a kick on the lunge.
techniques.timing: 43-90 f; field lunge peak 66 px/f.
techniques.use_when: Editing, resizing, aspect changes, expanding a field.
techniques.avoid_when: Smooth tweens for a tool action.

techniques.name: Result card pops and fills in sequence
techniques.summary: A result card pops in one frame, its price types in digit by digit in grey, then its actions and sources follow a few frames later.
techniques.recipe: Cards pop + TypeOn for the price + kit parts with starts. Anatomy: Card 1 f; price 1 char per 1-2 f; icons 2 f; sources +4 f. Sound: A chat pop.
techniques.use_when: The product's output (a quote, a report, an answer).
techniques.avoid_when: Everything inside the card arriving at once.

techniques.name: UI rises in, holds, launches out
techniques.summary: Each UI piece (input box, share sheet, composer, search field) rises 40-260 px into place, holds briefly, then accelerates up and out with a smear; a search field can whip in while the camera pulls back, type, and drift up.
techniques.recipe: Cards enterState + an exit on E.launchIn with a 2-frame vertical ghost. Anatomy: Rise expo-out, hold, ease-in exit with vertical smear; pull-back x0.65 quint-out. Sound: Whooshes on the exits; keypress ticks.
techniques.timing: Rise 22-32 f; exit 24-32 f; typing 38 f.
techniques.use_when: A rapid sequence of UI moments.
techniques.avoid_when: Fading out.

techniques.name: Skeleton placeholders hand over to content
techniques.summary: Cards first appear as blank or blurred slabs with grey bars for text (or a code panel with only its line numbers, or avatar circles), then the real content resolves in layers: the pin first, the text, then the photo; a selection dot pops last.
techniques.recipe: Cards with a skeleton face cross-switched to the content face (HardStep per layer). Anatomy: Blank slab 2-4 f; layers 2 f apart; gutter 26 f before the first code pixel. Sound: UI pops on each card.
techniques.timing: Hand-off 28 f; per card 4-6 f.
techniques.use_when: Loading states; anything the product fetches or generates.
techniques.avoid_when: Skeletons that last longer than about 0.5 s.

techniques.name: New item pushes in, older items step back
techniques.summary: A new toast or card takes the top slot and the older ones step down, shrink and blur in depth; new rows push a list up with a snap scroll (75 % in the first frame); a queue keeps three and fades the oldest; new pills enter tilted and demote the older ones.
techniques.recipe: Cards cardArrive + demote (at = the newcomer's first frame). Anatomy: Per entry 22 f; older items scale 0.82-0.9 and blur one level; stagger 8-16 f (shortening 18 -> 10 f in a run); the stack can accelerate up into the next shot. Sound: A bell, then dings per toast; kicks within 40 ms.
techniques.timing: Entries 22 f; snap scroll 10-22 f; cards on kicks 26, 15, 18 f apart.
techniques.use_when: Notifications, payments, steps of an agent, feature pills.
techniques.avoid_when: Older items that stay at full strength.

techniques.name: Answer streams and its card grows line by line
techniques.summary: A reply streams in 5-6 characters a frame, line by line, and its card grows a line at a time to hold it; several text blocks of one card can stream at once.
techniques.recipe: <TypeOn kind="stream"> inside a container whose height is snapBox() of the line count (HardStep) or an E.snapOut tween per line. Anatomy: Stream text; the container height snaps (or eases 6-10 f) per new line; variant: headline, outline and body blocks stream simultaneously with live re-wrapping. Sound: None per line; one soft pop when the card completes. Materials: A tiny caret blinks, becomes an empty outlined pill (1 px white at 50 %, about 70 px placeholder), then a small caps label types into it (about 1 character a frame at 60) while the pill snaps wider with every character, no ease.
techniques.timing: 60-150 characters a second; card fills in 29-50 f.
techniques.use_when: Showing an AI answer or a generated document.
techniques.avoid_when: Text the viewer must read in full.
techniques.materials: A tiny caret blinks, becomes an empty outlined pill (1 px white at 50 %, about 70 px placeholder), then a small caps label types into it (about 1 character a frame at 60) while the pill snaps wider with every character, no ease.

techniques.name: Bubbles spring-pop from their tail corner
techniques.summary: Speech bubbles pop around a subject in a photo, each scaling up from its tail corner with a small spring, on the voice's cadence.
techniques.recipe: springBox per bubble with transformOrigin at the tail. Anatomy: Scale from the tail anchor; spring zeta 0.62; irregular gaps from the voice. Sound: Chat pops. Materials: Each bubble starts as a short white dash (20 x 3 px) exactly at its tail corner for 2 f, then a tiny squashed bubble springs out from the tail (spring about 8 f, damping 12) and settles in 6 f.
techniques.timing: Rise 12-14 f, settle 40 f; gaps 6-26 f.
techniques.use_when: Questions or messages around a person in footage.
techniques.avoid_when: Spending the spring elsewhere in the same film.
techniques.materials: Each bubble starts as a short white dash (20 x 3 px) exactly at its tail corner for 2 f, then a tiny squashed bubble springs out from the tail (spring about 8 f, damping 12) and settles in 6 f.

techniques.name: Tile wall whips in with per-tile parallax
techniques.summary: A wall of artwork tiles enters with heavy horizontal blur, each tile decelerating at its own rate (near tiles travel further), then the wall accelerates out and the next wall comes in.
techniques.recipe: parallax layers per tile row with whip in and out. Anatomy: Per-tile travel scaled by depth; blur on the fast frames. Sound: Whooshes.
techniques.timing: In 28 f, out 16 f cubic-in, next wall 52 f.
techniques.use_when: Galleries of work; a portfolio beat.
techniques.avoid_when: All tiles on one curve.

techniques.name: Words drop into the line from above
techniques.summary: Each word drops a short way into its slot from above, from a muted grey to the ink, trailing a short vertical smear; the last word lands in the accent and cools.
techniques.recipe: Word w starts at at + 9w f; p = prog(f, o, o + 12, E.snapOut); translateY = -0.28 em x (1 - p); opacity = 0.4 + 0.6p; colour mixColor(mute, ink, p); a smear of 0.12 em x (1 - p) above it (two or three fading copies). The last word mixes toward the accent instead and cools to the ink over 30 f after it lands. As one line: `<TypeLine spec={{ preset: 'fall', text, at }}>`.
techniques.timing: Per word 12 f, 9 f apart (8-10), drop 0.28 em (0.2-0.3); a four-word line lands in about 40 f.
techniques.use_when: A line over a dark, deep ground (a product world, a night UI) where a rise from below would fight the composition; a claim that settles down onto the product.
techniques.avoid_when: Two lines in a row that both drop; a light, airy film where the canonical rise is the voice.

techniques.name: Words track apart into a zoom
techniques.summary: The line leaves by its words tracking apart faster and faster while the camera zooms toward the first word; the words go from the end, right to left, and the cut lands on the peak.
techniques.recipe: From `out`: q = (f - out) / 26; word w moves +0.5 em x w x E.launchIn(q); the line scales x1.6^E.launchIn(q) about the first word's centre; word w (rank r from the last) fades over 8 f from 26 x (0.4 + 0.45 r / (n - 1)) f. Cut on frame 26 (the first words still show). For a TypeLine: `exit: 'spread'`.
techniques.timing: 26 f; word drift 0.5 em per word index; zoom x1.6 (x2.3 when the camera carries on into the next shot); fades 8 f, right to left.
techniques.use_when: A line that hands over to a bigger moment (a drop, a product reveal) through a zoom; typed lines that should leave as typing became motion.
techniques.avoid_when: A quiet line before a hold; two tracking exits in one film.

techniques.name: Tracking collapses into the cut
techniques.summary: A held line contracts toward its centre, letter spacing collapsing faster and faster with each glyph smeared toward the edge it left, and is cut while it moves.
techniques.recipe: From `out`: p = E.buildIn((f - out) / 10); each glyph moves -12 % of its distance from the line's centre x p; a trail of that frame's travel toward the edge. Cut on frame 10 (about 9 % narrower on the last frame shown). For a TypeLine: `exit: 'collapse'`.
techniques.timing: 10 f (4-5 f at 30 fps); 9-12 % narrower at the cut.
techniques.use_when: A caption that should leave without a direction, sucked into the next shot (a search field, a chip, a mark at the centre).
techniques.avoid_when: Long lines (the outer glyphs travel too far); a line that should be read again.
